subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should the scheduled review shard receive short-lived Pull requests write permission and proceed under a maintainer proof override with monitored post-merge validation?
rationale: The permission is necessary for PR timeline comments but grants broader mutation capability, while scheduled default-branch behavior cannot be positively demonstrated from the unmerged branch.

options.title: Approve monitored rollout
options.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, apply an explicit proof override, merge, and validate the next normal pull-request and issue review run.

options.title: Keep the shard read-only
options.body: Pause this approach and move lease/status publication to an already write-authorized job if the review shard should not hold Pull requests write permission.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the App installation and Codex credential isolation, apply an explicit proof override, merge, and validate the next normal pull-request and issue review run.
